Don Toliver Confirms New Album ‘Nitrous’ Set To Release This Year

by Armaan Yadav
September 7, 2026
Höre Don Toliver
auf Amazon Music Unlimited (ad)
Listen to audio version of this article

Don Toliver has been crafting a serious lane of his own with a fresh sound in hip hop that is as mesmerising live as it is on streaming. His last album Octane continued to turned heads, and he’s not stopping anytime soon.

Fans have speculated on the release timeline for his next album project Nitrous, only to find no confirmation as to when the album will actually come out; until now. At his most recent show in Brooklyn, Don Toliver not only brought out an incredible roster of artists such as Cardi B, Sexyy Red, Cash Cobain, Slick Rick, Busta Rhymes and more, he also confirmed the Nitrous timeline.

1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE

The artist confirmed he’s dropping the album sometime this year. Speaking candidly to fans while on stage, Toliver said “I’m gon do this shit again this year,” while closing the remark with an exciting “wonder what they will say” when he does it again this year. Truly, the confidence is at an all time high and we are here for it! Check out the interaction below.
